# jst

## preamble

```{r load-deps, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(arrow)
library(scuttle)
library(BiocParallel)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
source("code/_utils.R")
bp <- MulticoreParam(4)
```

## loading

```{r load-data}
pbs <- readRDS("outs/qbs.rds")
sce <- readRDS("outs/fil.rds")
ist <- readRDS("outs/lv1.rds")
```

## wrangling

```{r add-epi}
# include epithelia in stromal compartment
ist$clust[ist$clust == "epi"] <- "str"
epi <- colnames(ist$profiles) == "epi"
colnames(ist$profiles)[epi] <- "str"
```

```{r prep-data}
sce <- logNormCounts(sce)
sub <- sort(unique(ist$clust))
names(sub) <- sub <- setdiff(sub, "epi")
lapply(pbs, colnames); table(ist$clust)
```

## selection

```{r sel}
mx <- normalizeCounts(ist$profiles)
names(ks) <- ks <- unique(colnames(mx))
mx <- sapply(ks, \(k) rowMeans(mx[, k, drop=FALSE]))
sel <- lapply(ks, \(.) {
    my <- mx[, setdiff(ks, .)]
    fc <- apply(my, 2, \(x) mx[, .]/x)
    fc[!is.finite(fc)] <- NA
    fc <- rowMins(fc, na.rm=TRUE)
    fc <- fc[!is.na(fc) & is.finite(fc) & fc > 2]
    gs <- names(tail(sort(fc), 2e3))
})
sapply(ks, \(.) {
    se <- sce[, names(which(ist$clust == .))]
    gs <- intersect(rownames(se), sel[[.]])
    summary(tot <- colSums(assay(se)[gs, ]))
})
# exclude Ig-related features for tumor subclustering
sel$tum <- grepv("^IG(H|K|L)", sel$tum, invert=TRUE)
sapply(sel, length)
```

```{r sel--, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
mx <- normalizeCounts(ist$profiles, log=TRUE)
sel <- lapply(sub, \(i) {
    j <- setdiff(sub, i)
    i <- which(colnames(mx) == i)
    a <- mx[, i, drop=FALSE]
    b <- rowMeans(mx[, j, drop=FALSE])
    fc <- apply(a, 2, \(.) ./b)
    fc <- rowMeans(fc, na.rm=TRUE)
    fc <- fc[is.finite(fc) & fc > 2]
    names(tail(sort(fc), 2e3))
})
sapply(sub, \(.) {
    se <- sce[, names(which(ist$clust == .))]
    gs <- intersect(rownames(se), sel[[.]])
    summary(tot <- colSums(assay(se)[gs, ]))
})
sapply(sel, length)
```

```{r sel-, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
cat("MYE\n"); grepv("C1Q|HLA-D|APOE|CD14|CD68", sel$mye) |> sort()
cat("\nSTR\n"); grepv("VWF|CD93|^COL|HEY1|LYVE|MARCO|KRT", sel$str) |> sort()
cat("\nNKT\n"); grepv("^(CD2|CD3|CD4|CD8|GZM|FOXP3|TIGIT)", sel$nkt) |> sort()
cat("\nTUM\n"); grepv("TOP|TUBB|MKI|CCND|SOX|IGH|MZB|IRF4|CIITA|CD19|CD83|MS4A1", sel$tum) |> sort()
```

## clustering

```{r echo=FALSE}
run <- !file.exists(out <- "outs/jst.rds")
```

```{r clu, eval=run, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results="hide"}
jst <- bplapply(sub, \(.) {
    set.seed(260222)
    se <- sce[, names(which(ist$clust == .))]
    ex <- colSums(assay(se)[sel[[.]], ] > 0) < 10
    ns <- c(1e4, 2e4, 1e5)/ifelse(. == "tum", 2, 5)
    nk <- if (. == "mye") seq(2, 4) else if (. != "nkt") seq(3, 9) else 0
    ist <- .ist(se[, !ex], nk=nk, ns=ns, gs=sel[[.]], pbs=pbs[[.]])
    ks <- intersect(letters, unique(ist$clust))
    ks <- c(ks, sort(colnames(pbs[[.]])))
    ist$clust <- factor(ist$clust, ks)
    ist
}, BPPARAM=bp)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
if (!run) jst <- readRDS(out) else saveRDS(jst, out)
```

## visuals

### embedding

```{r plt-fp, fig.width=12, fig.height=3.5, warning=FALSE}
wrap_plots(lapply(names(jst), \(.) .plt_fp(jst[[.]], .)), nrow=1)
```

### abundance

```{r plt-ist-fq1, fig.width=12, fig.height=3}
#| code-fold: true
lapply(sub, \(.) {
    kid <- droplevels(kid <- jst[[.]]$clust)
    sce$ist <- kid[match(colnames(sce), names(kid))]
    .plt_fq(sce, "sid", "ist", id=., h=TRUE)
}) |> wrap_plots(nrow=1)
```

```{r plt-ist-fq2, fig.width=6, fig.height=3, fig.align="center"}
#| code-fold: true
ps <- lapply(sub, \(.) {
    kid <- droplevels(kid <- jst[[.]]$clust)
    sce$ist <- kid[match(colnames(sce), names(kid))]
    .plt_fq(sce, "ist", "sid", id=.)
}) 
ws <- sapply(ps, \(p) nlevels(p$data$Var1))
wrap_plots(ps, guides="collect", widths=ws)
```

### markers

:::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r plt-de, results="asis", fig.align="default", fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
#| code-fold: true
lapply(sub, \(.) {
    cat("###",.,"\n:::{.panel-tabset}\n")
    mx <- (kst <- jst[[.]])$profiles
    n1 <- ifelse(. == "str", 10, 20)
    ps <- .plt_de(kst, "all", n1=n1, n2=80); names(ps)[1] <- "all"
    for (. in names(ps)) {cat("####",.,"\n"); print(ps[[.]]); cat("\n\n")}
    cat(":::\n")
})
```

::::

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r plt-ist-mg, results="asis", fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
#| code-fold: true
ps <- lapply(sub, \(.) {
    gs <- .mgs[[.]]
    se <- sce[, names(which(ist$clust == .))]
    ks <- droplevels(jst[[.]]$clust)
    se$. <- ks[match(colnames(se), names(ks))]
    na <- setdiff(levels(ks), names(gs))
    gs <- c(gs, lapply(setNames(na, na), \(.) c()))
    .plt_dp(se, ".", gs, hc=!. %in% c("nkt", "mye"))
})
for (. in names(ps)) {cat("####",.,"\n"); print(ps[[.]]); cat("\n\n")}
```

## labeling

```{r lab}
lab <- list(
    str=list(
        FRCtcz="a",
        epi=c("b", "f"),
        mCAF="c",
        fib="d",
        FRCpv="e",
        BEC="g",
        FRCcts="h",
        LEC="i"
    ),
    mye=list(
        DC="DC",
        pDC="pDC", 
        mono.nc=c("mono.nc"),
        mono.c=c("mono.c", "b"),
        macro="a",
        moDC="c"
    ),
    nkt=list(
        NK="NK",
        Thn="Thn",
        Tcm="Tcm",
        Treg="Treg",
        Tfh=c("Tfh", "a"),
        Tem=c("Tem", "b"),
        Tcn=c("Tcn", "d"),
        Tex=c("Tex", "Tra", "c")
    )
)
lab$tum$tum <- setdiff(levels(jst$tum$clust), names(lab$tum))
kst <- lapply(sub, \(.) .jst(jst[[.]], lab[[.]]))
kst <- lapply(kst, \(.) {.$clust <- factor(.$clust, exclude="x"); .})
sapply(kst, \(.) table(.$clust, exclude=NULL))
```

## visuals

```{r vis}
kid <- unlist(unname(lapply(kst, \(.) .$clust)))
sce$lv2 <- kid[match(colnames(sce), names(kid))]
sce$lv1 <- ist$clust[match(colnames(sce), names(ist$clust))]
lys <- lapply(split(seq(ncol(sce)), ist$clust), \(.) sce[, .])
for (. in names(lys)) lys[[.]]$lv2 <- droplevels(lys[[.]]$lv2)
```

### abundance

```{r plt-jst-fq1, fig.width=12, fig.height=3}

wrap_plots(ps, nrow=1)
```

```{r plt-jst-fq2, fig.width=6, fig.height=3, fig.align="center"}

ps <- lapply(sub[sub != "tum"], \(.) .plt_fq(lys[[.]], "lv2", "sid", id=.))
ws <- sapply(ps, \(p) nlevels(p$data$Var1))
wrap_plots(ps, guides="collect", widths=ws)
```

### spatial

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r plt-xy, results="asis", fig.width=6, fig.height=3, message=FALSE}
#| code-fold: true
df <- read_parquet("outs/pol.parquet", as_data_frame=FALSE)
names(id) <- id <- names(cs <- split(seq(ncol(sce)), sce$sid))
pal <- setNames(.pal_kid, levels(sce$lv2))
l1 <- scale_fill_manual(NULL, values=.pal_sub)
l2 <- scale_fill_manual(NULL, values=pal)
ps <- lapply(id, \(.) {
    se <- sce[, cs[[.]]]
    (.plt_ps(df, se, "lv1", id=.) + l1) +
    (.plt_ps(df, se, "lv2") + l2) +
    plot_layout(nrow=1)
})
for (. in names(ps)) { cat("####", ., "\n"); print(ps[[.]]); cat("\n\n") }
```
